configuration: the official example deck examples/compartmental/morphotest.py, run as shipped (SAB_DURATION_SCALE 1.0 = upstream window) against the pip-installed brian2 2.10.1 package (codegen target auto: Cython runtime), one single-threaded process, matplotlib Agg with show() disabled; the RNG (numpy and brian2.seed) is seeded from ic/<ic>/seed.txt before the deck runs; the deck builds no monitor, so the driver then reads from the deck namespace the values the deck prints, neuron.v (13), neuron.L.v (7), neuron.LL.v (2) and neuron.L.main.v (5) in V, then distance, area, diameter and length of all 13 compartments (SI units), float64, in trace.f64
variant: a different RNG seed (12346 instead of 12345): the deck's stochastic elements (random connectivity, noise terms, Poisson inputs) draw a different realization, which exercises the policy on statistics that must be seed-robust; a deck that seeds itself or draws nothing produces an identical variant and the calibration records that it supplies no evidence
altbuild: none: brian2 is a Python/Cython package built one way by pip; runtime codegen variation is not a build and the seed variant already probes legitimate numerical variation

evidence.spread_how: selfcheck runs nominal and variant (seeds 12345/12346) and records the spread of each graded quantity in self-validation.json

comparison.rule: every exported value must agree pointwise within rtol 1e-5, atol 1e-10

warrant: The deck builds a soma with three cylinder branches (13 compartments), sets v to 0..12 V by compartment index and prints v through the whole tree, a subtree (L), a sub-subtree (LL) and a subtree main section (L.main). It demonstrates morphology indexing: which compartments each subtree view addresses. Nothing is integrated and nothing is random, so a correct build reproduces every value exactly. Wrong subtree indexing returns different integers (off by at least 1 V, 1e10 times the atol), and wrong geometry (compartment splitting, area of the soma sphere) changes distance, area, diameter or length far past rtol 1e-5.
observable: the values the deck prints, neuron.v (13), neuron.L.v (7), neuron.LL.v (2) and neuron.L.main.v (5) in V, then distance, area, diameter and length of all 13 compartments (SI units), float64, in trace.f64
